content: TUI design references for a terminal social/feed reader (fetched 2026-10-14): newsboat (C++, pushed 2026-10-10) separate urls/config files, macros, query feeds, built-in HTML renderer; neomutt (pushed 2026-10-13) index->pager->back contract, '?' shows current bindings, notmuch saved queries; aerc (Go, active) panes + ':' commands + never block the UI on a slow backend; tut (Go/Bubble Tea, 503*, dormant since 2023-12-18) ':' command set, panes, templates, xdg-open media; mastui (Python/Textual, release 2026-09-03) multi-column collapsing layout, per-profile config/keymap/cache, SQLite offline cache, ANSI/Sixel/TGP image auto-detect, URL-extractor modal, F12 log viewer; tooi (Codeberg Go, 0.27.0 2026-07-04) TUI split out of the toot CLI; hackernews-tui (722*, pushed 2026-03-29) read-only single-source reader with config + per-view shortcuts; tuir/rtv (dead 2020/2019, archived 2023-02-20) mailcap media opener + $TUIR_BROWSER/$TUIR_URLVIEWER + clipboard_cmd + themes; scli (Signal, urwid) vim keys, command entry, optional history; iamb (Matrix, pushed 2026-10-13). Terminal capability: Ghostty supports the Kitty graphics protocol (ghostty.org/docs/features); tmux needs DCS passthrough for it (xeet).
